text:
arjun: Heads-up — PR #5891 is failing CI on a snapshot test (BrowserIntegrationTest > canvas-snapshot). Failing on macOS-latest job. Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/7423 :eyes:
ci-bot: CI summary for PR #5891:
- job: macos-integration (failed)
- failed tests: BrowserIntegrationTest::canvas-snapshot (1 flaky failure)
- last run: 2026-03-17T14:04:50Z
Commands:
```
# rerun the single job
ci rerun job 7423
# run locally
yarn test BrowserIntegrationTest --testNamePattern="canvas-snapshot"
```

maria: on it, fetching the branch now. running the test locally.

maria: local run reproduced the diff. looks like header padding changed a pixel after CSS tweak in my PR. might be intended.

sarah: can you paste the snapshot diff or a screenshot? want to confirm it's expected.

maria: attaching inline diff snippet:
```
-<div class="header" style="padding: 12px">
+<div class="header" style="padding: 13px">
```
maria: small change in padding. i think snapshot should be updated.

dena: if it's intentional, update snapshots in the branch and force-push. Also add a short note in the PR about visual tweak so reviewers know it's not a regression. :+1:

arjun: quick FYI — if we update snapshots, CI will run again. We should avoid committing unrelated snapshot noise. Keep updates scoped.

maria: doing `yarn test --updateSnapshot BrowserIntegrationTest --testNamePattern="canvas-snapshot"` now, then `git add` the updated snapshot file.

maria: pushed snapshot update, PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5891/files Updated tests/snapshots/canvas/*.snap

sarah: looking. If CI is green after update i'll approve. Also can we add a tiny unit to assert header padding to avoid future accidental drift?

maria: yeah I can add a focused unit test in a follow-up — don't want to bloat this PR. will open ticket.

ci-bot: Reran job macos-integration (7423) — now: SUCCESS.

dena: sweet, thanks. arjun — do you want to merge once you have one more LGTM?

arjun: yup. i'll wait for one more reviewer. @sarah any objections to me merging after your review?

sarah: no objections. left a small comment about test coverage, but not blocking. LGTM. :thumbsup:

arjun: thanks all — merging once GitHub shows green. CI notes: if this flakes again we should mark the test flaky and open a stabilization ticket.

maria: noted, will add the ticket if it reappears. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.

ci-bot: PR #5891 merged by arjun at 2026-03-17T14:07:22Z.

arjun: merging complete. closing thread.
